For the Ones Who Are Gone
Click 🎧 to listen.
Listen to a conversation between two students. The boy is discussing his opinion about an old music manuscript his family kept. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the boy gives to support his opinion. As you listen, you may take notes.
Listen to the Conversation
1QUESTION 1:
Why does the boy talk about the radio song?
2QUESTION 2:
Where did the boy first hear the old song?
3QUESTION 3:
According to the boy, what makes the old song sound different from the radio song?
4QUESTION 4:
What does the boy mean when he says the old song “carries everybody”?
Answer all 4 questions to submit.
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
SMART SUPPORT:
Go back to the conversation. Locate the line where the boy says why he picked the old song. Locate the line that tells where the old song came from. Locate the line about the slow part near the end. Locate the line about the ones who are gone.
